name: Fruit drink
ingredients_raw: PURIFIED WATER, SUGAR, MANGO JUICE (7.5%), APPLE JUICE (7.5%), CARBON DIOXIDE (INS290), ACIDITY REGULATORS (INS296, INS330 & INS331), VITAMIN C PERMITTED CLASS II PRESERVATIVE (INS122) AND HONEY. CONTAINS PERMITTED SYNTHETIC COLOURS (INS102 & INS133). CONTAINS PERMITTED NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOUR (MANGO)
